title: Synthesis — Denso informativo
description: A whole-board proposal tuned for information density: uppercase destinations for a distinct display register, scheduled clock times in place of decaying countdowns, a unified leading-dot vocabulary across states, and a pluralized column label.

changes.intent: Uppercase destinations with light tracking as a distinct register from the sentence-case header.
Keep the stop name sentence-case as the contrast anchor.
Show the scheduled clock time rather than a countdown for PRÓXIMO/later rows.
changes.detail: Derive `scheduledTime = format(now + etaMinutes, 'HH:mm')` (same formatter as the header clock) and render it in place of the countdown for non-now/non-departing rows; the .arrival-row__eta-unit span is omitted for those rows. 'ahora'/'SALIENDO' keep their existing labels; the ≥60 min hours format still applies to any row shown as a countdown.

changes.intent: Add a leading dot to ABORDANDO and PRÓXIMO matching SALIENDO's dot vocabulary.
PRÓXIMO dot is an amber outline (upcoming, not yet current).
Match the label to the multi-row content.
changes.detail: Change the second header span text from 'Próxima salida' to 'Próximas salidas'.
